sources.roc_curve, recall_at_fpr: sklearn.metrics.roc_curve(drop_intermediate=False); max TPR with FPR <= target, highest threshold on ties
sources.threshold_sweep: sklearn.metrics.confusion_matrix / fbeta_score(beta=2) at each distinct score
sources.cost_weighted: brute force over the sklearn ROC points: cost_fn*pi*(1-TPR) + cost_fp*(1-pi)*FPR, first minimum
sources.prevalence_adjusted: closed form PPV/NPV (Bayes' rule); research example TPR 0.9, FPR 0.05, pi 0.01 -> PPV 0.154
